tasks.label: Build Aseprite extension
tasks.command: rm -f sms-gg.aseprite-extension && zip -r -q sms-gg.aseprite-extension sms-gg -x '*.DS_Store' && echo 'Built sms-gg.aseprite-extension'

tasks.label: Build and install into Aseprite
tasks.command: mkdir -p ~/.config/aseprite/extensions/sms-gg-export && cp sms-gg/* ~/.config/aseprite/extensions/sms-gg-export/ && echo 'Installed. Restart Aseprite to load changes.'

osx.command: mkdir -p ~/Library/Application\ Support/Aseprite/extensions/sms-gg-export && cp sms-gg/* ~/Library/Application\ Support/Aseprite/extensions/sms-gg-export/ && echo 'Installed. Restart Aseprite to load changes.'

windows.command: New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$env:APPDATA\Aseprite\extensions\sms-gg-export" | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Force sms-gg\* "$env:APPDATA\Aseprite\extensions\sms-gg-export\"; echo 'Installed. Restart Aseprite to load changes.'
